results.evidence: Fourth pass, 2026-09-30. Still no published account of how Rimrock Ridge is approached or climbed, so no replacement approach text can be sourced. Searched: web searches on Rimrock Ridge with Stehekin / Agnes Creek / Flat Creek / West Fork Agnes / Spruce Creek / Old Guard / Le Conte / Bannock / Agnes Mountain / 'trip report' return only peak-database listings (7,254-7,260 ft, prominence ~1,320 ft, saddle ~5,940 ft, parent Old Guard Peak, Goode Mountain quad), topo-map feature pages and unrelated Rimrock trails in Oregon/Colorado/Montana. The two peak lists (ascent pages) answer with a Cloudflare check and have no usable Wayback copy (CDX empty or archive offline during this pass); the bot checks were not bypassed. Two independent Agnes Mountain trip reports were read in full and neither mentions Rimrock Ridge; one of them describes exactly the leg now stored on this row: Agnes Creek trail ~8.5 mi from High Bridge to Swamp Creek Camp, cross Agnes Creek and Spruce Creek on logs, ~1,000 ft of thick brush above Spruce Creek, high camp in upper Blue Basin at ~6,500 ft. So the stored 'bushwhack east from Swamp Creek Camp into upper Agnes Creek/Blue Basin' text is the Agnes Mountain approach transplanted onto this row (the row's own data_quality.gaps[0] says as much), and it ends below Agnes Mountain, not Rimrock Ridge (Rimrock's summit, 48.3756,-120.9783, lies NW of Swamp Creek Camp, 48.3096,-120.9204). A Ptarmigan Traverse report covering Old Guard Peak (Rimrock's parent) also never mentions Rimrock. Beckey's Cascade Alpine Guide (vol. 2) may list the ridge, but the archive.org copies are lending-restricted (search-inside returns 'Item not available') and the Google Books API quota was exhausted; the Open Library full-text index has no hit for Rimrock Ridge. Two GNIS-style coordinates are in circulation (summit 48.3755664,-120.9782611; ridge feature 48.3720712,-121.0001074) — noted only. Recommendation for a person with a map (no ops): either replace the approach/itinerary leg with an explicitly unsourced 'no known approach' statement, or drop the Swamp Creek/Blue Basin text and the Swamp Creek Camp waypoint, since both describe Agnes Mountain. No ops.

Fourth pass, 2026-09-30. Each line still has exactly ONE independent source. Line A (East Face, 4th class, 300 ft, 'a series of zig-zagging ledges generally on the E/SE side', a short 4th-class hand-crack variation, 'Reverse the route to descend', approach S/SE from Aasgard Pass to below the E side): only the route database's own page; its area page lists it as the tower's only route. Line B (Southeast Face, 'goes up the white rock one pitch 5.6'): only the peak page (read via its 2024-10-14 Wayback copy, id_ raw). That peak page's route list (South Route class 3, SE Face 5.6, West Buttress 5.4, NW Buttress 5.7, NE Face 5.8) is plainly drawn from Beckey's Cascade Alpine Guide, but Beckey could not be read: the archive.org copies (1973, 1987, 2000 editions) are lending-restricted and search-inside returns 'Item not available'; Google Books API quota exhausted; Open Library full-text has only a passing mention in Nelson/Potterfield's Selected Climbs (no route). The encyclopedia article cites Beckey only for 'easiest route class 3'. Checked and not usable as a second source: the club's two route pages (South Face scramble: 'scramble the south face'; Southwest Corner 5.5) — no east/southeast line, and the archive holds no other Witches Tower page from that club; a 2014 forum thread on the NW Buttress (archived copy read; one party glissaded 'down the SE side', nothing on either line); a 2013 blog (West Buttress); a 2014 blog (unnamed 'exposed scramble'); the 2006 report and the peak page's own 2005 photo caption ('traverses on a semi-exposed slabby ledge around to the east side') both describe the South Route scramble (ledge around to the east side, then large black blocks, 4-ft slot), which already has its own row (wa_witches_tower_south_face). The 2008 forum 'Parade Route' trip report is behind a JS cookie check (not bypassed) and has no Wayback capture under its current or old ubbthreads URL (CDX searched for both); the NWHikers threads are behind Cloudflare with no archive. Peak-list ascent pages: Cloudflare, no archive for this peak. Note, not a source: the South Route ends on the east side via ledges, so Line A may be a variant of it, but no source says so. Recommendation unchanged (no ops): keep this row as the East Face (4th, ledges, reverse to descend — what grade/beta/pitch_detail/descent/bail/summit waypoint already say) and strip the 5.6 'white rock' content from itinerary (days[0].note, schedule[4], objective, cal, totalNote), descent_text and rope_note/rack once a second source for either line appears; a separate 'Southeast Face 5.6' row would need its own second source.
